title: Why brick walls have tiny open gaps near the bottom
beats: Ever notice small gaps in brick walls?
Rainwater can penetrate the outer brick layer, collecting in an air space. Flashing then directs this moisture down to the weep openings.
So those small gaps aren't mistakes; they're essential drainage, protecting your home. Follow Hidden Logic for more everyday explanations.

title: Why your denim shows white on the inside
beats: Blue jeans are white inside, why?
Denim uses blue warp yarns lengthwise and white filling yarns crosswise. The twill weave brings more blue threads to the surface, hiding white underneath.
So, your blue jeans are white inside because of that specific weave. Follow Hidden Logic for more everyday explanations.
